column1: # TITLE: miRNA expression in H460 cells treated with sulforaphane

# SUMMARY: H460 cells treated with vehicle or sulforaphane (SFN) for 48 hours were used to acquire expression profiles of a total of 1891 unique miRNAs. We aimed at identifying the differentially expressed miRNAs between cells treated or untreated with SFN.
